P.name: Sunlight
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Leona's''' {{tip|abilities}} mark enemies hit for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.

Allied {{tip|champions|champions'}} damaging attacks and abilities against a marked target will consume the mark to deal {{as|{{pplevel|32 to 151}}|magic damage}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.

Q.name: Shield of Daybreak
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Leona''' illuminates her shield, empowering her next {{tip|basic attack}} within 6 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{tip|stun}} the target for 1 second.
Q.description2: ''Shield of Daybreak {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Leona's''' basic attack timer.''

W.name: Eclipse
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Leona''' raises her ''guard'' for 3 seconds, gaining flat {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} damage reduction of up to 50% of the damage instance and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}.
W.description2: Her shield detonates after the duration, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. If this hits an enemy, '''Leona's''' ''guard'' is extended for an additional 3 seconds.

E.name: Zenith Blade
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Leona''' projects her sword in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
E.description2: After reaching its maximum range, if the sword hit an enemy {{tip|champion}} during its flight, '''Leona''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to 225 units beyond the location of the last champion struck and {{tip|root|roots}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
E.description3: '''''Leona''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move or attack while Zenith Blade is in flight. She can cast any of her abilities during the dash.''

R.name: Solar Flare
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Leona''' calls down a solar flare that strikes upon the target location after {{fd|0.625}} seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area before impact and for another 3 seconds afterwards. Enemies hit are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 80% for {{fd|1.75}} seconds, and are also {{tip|stun|stunned}} for the same duration if they are struck by the epicenter.
